yearsToFirstCrop.notes: No transferable planting-to-first-food age. Trial days after sowing are accession, place and season specific, not a perennial age curve.

yearsToFullBearing.notes: No universal full-bearing age applies to this annual or dual-purpose crop.

yieldKgPerTreeMature.notes: Trial grain kg/ha is retained as a reference only; it is not kg/plant or household food yield.

chillUnits.notes: No numeric crop-specific chilling requirement is verified.

pollination.notes: No household-food pollination classification is inferred from a grain trial.

harvestProduct: food grain, immature pods or cooked leaves; forage biomass is separate

supplementaryReferences.title: SA accession maturity and grain trial
supplementaryReferences.doc: Ayisi, Bopape and Pengelly: ACIAR Proceedings 115 (2004), Tables 3 and 5, pp46 and49
supplementaryReferences.note: Dalmada near Polokwane, 2002/03; sown 10 December on clay loam with 297 mm rain plus 178 mm irrigation. Paired physiological maturity days after planting / grain kg/ha: CPI 52552 99.3 / 576.2; CPI 60795 99.0 / 570.5; CQ 3620 99.0 / 574.2; Rongai black 197.0 / 2.6, brown 197.0 / 3.3, white 197.0 / 7.4. Tables visually checked. Maturity means 90% brown pods; biomass Table 4 is separate. The authors require farmer evaluation of eating qualities, so trial accessions are not verified food purchase recommendations.

productionGuidance.products: food grain, immature pods or cooked leaves; forage biomass is separate
care: Choose the intended food part and appropriate preparation; confirm the actual food type with a local adviser. Food and fodder harvests are different operations.
The existing 2–6 t/ha research figure is forage/green-manure dry matter, not beans for people. Late forage Rongai cannot inherit an early grain accession’s timing or yield.
purchase: Obtain identified material for the intended food or forage purpose. Availability and eating quality of early trial accessions are unverified; record the purchased type and actual sowing and picking dates.

sourceChecks.observations: Primary publication or producer page checked; product, cultivar, location and native units retained. Generic age, plant yield and calendar remain unknown.

gaps: An actual farm cultivar, sowing date, product purpose and applicable local harvest window are required; reference trials do not create an automatic annual forecast.
